dedupe_keys.name: sandre exchange scenario for self monitoring data of sewer collection and wastewater treatment systems france

description: This Sandre document defines the technical scenario for exchanging self-monitoring data from sewer collection systems and wastewater treatment plants in France, updated in May 2017 to replace version 3.0 of April 2012 and validated on 5 July 2017. It is published by the French ministry in charge of the environment with input from a national group of sanitation experts, as two booklets in PDF and an XML schema, and points to related Sandre dictionaries for pollution control works and a control description for the reference register of those works. Coverage: all of France, describing message formats, not measurements. Access: free; the rights are Creative Commons 2.0 BY-NC-SA France. Caveats: it is a data exchange specification, not a dataset, and the actual overflow readings sit in other portals. It supports interoperable overflow and treatment monitoring and network capacity analysis, and relates to the French collective sanitation portal record in the catalogue.
